definitions.supplemental: Prompt. Parv. snytynge of a nose or candyl munctura, emunctura.
definitions.meaning: A clearing of the nose, sneezing

quotations.old_english: Snýtingc vel fneósung sternutatio vel sternutamentum

source_text: snýting, e; f. A clearing of the nose, sneezing:--Snýtingc vel fneósung sternutatio vel sternutamentum, Wrt. Voc. i. 46, 20. [Prompt. Parv. snytynge of a nose or candyl munctura, emunctura.] v. snýtan.
